confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live price checks. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and booking window. FX: I could not confirm a current RBA observation. The latest one I could verify is 2026-03-20, so the rate may be stale; a 15 Oct 2026 figure of about 0.6955 was reported by search but was not confirmed against the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Dutch and Western European urban price levels (comparable to The Hague and Utrecht, slightly below Amsterdam) with July tourism-season accommodation pricing. No specific listings were inspected.
